topic.title: About conditional processing
topic.shortdesc: Certain concepts are critical for a full understanding of conditional processing.

dlentry.dd: A process that determines whether content is included, excluded, or flagged. This process is based on a comparison of conditional-processing attributes in the DITA source with the rules that are set in one or more DITAVAL documents.

dd.p: Attributes that can be used for filtering and flagging. These are the following attributes:

ul.li: The rev attribute, which supports flagging but not filtering

dlentry.dd: A set of rules that are provided to a processor for use at rendering time. These rules are expressed using DITAVAL documents.

A document that specifies a set of rules that define which elements to include, exclude, or flag. A DITAVAL document can be a file on the file system, a set of rules stored in memory, or another way of storing information that is expressed using DITAVAL syntax.
The process of including or excluding content at rendering time.

The process of emphasizing content by inserting images, text, or stylistic formatting at rendering time.
DITAVAL documents also support flagging by passing through conditional processing attributes into rendered output, and by adding outputclass values to elements..
